_about: Copy to $NAVI_DATA/seats.json and fill in. Seats are named saved logins per site; each one is logged in once, by the user, from Settings > Logins. A buyer's view is filmed with the owner seat on the member-facing pages. A business is a test only when the user lists it in $NAVI_DATA/test-businesses.json; every other business counts as real (the action guard blocks changes there that the job didn't ask for).
